title: Task-Related Token Compression in Multimodal Large Language Models from an Explainability Perspective
selection_reason: The abstract proposes instruction-related visual-token compression at the LLM input stage, using explainability to remove task-irrelevant tokens; it reports faster inference, lower prefill time, and lower KV-cache memory.
